cat > src/routes/contact.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
import { s } from 'kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import ContactForm from '../components/contact-form.kay'

const newMessage = s.Object({
  name: s.String({ maxLength: 200 }),
  email: s.String({ maxLength: 320 }),
  message: s.String({ maxLength: 5000 }),
})

export const send = action(newMessage, (input, ctx) => {
  const errors = checkContact(input)

  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0)
    return ctx.fail(422, { errors })

  return { name: input.name.trim() }
})
---
head
  title Contact
h1 Contact
ContactForm
EOF
cat > src/components/contact-form.kay <<'EOF'
---
import { send } from '../routes/contact.kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import type { ContactErrors } from '../contact'

const errors = signal<ContactErrors>(send.failed()?.data?.errors ?? {})
const thanked = signal(send.succeeded()?.data.name ?? '')

async function submit(event: SubmitEvent) {
  event.preventDefault()
  const form = event.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement
  const fields = new FormData(form)
  const found = checkContact({
    name: String(fields.get('name') ?? ''),
    email: String(fields.get('email') ?? ''),
    message: String(fields.get('message') ?? ''),
  })

  errors.set(found)
  thanked.set('')

  if (Object.keys(found).length === 0) {
    thanked.set((await send(fields, { refresh: false })).name)
    form.reset()
  }
}
---
if thanked()
  p(role="status") Thanks, {thanked()}! Your message has been sent.
form(action={send} novalidate onSubmit={submit})
  .field
    label(for="contact-name") Name
    input#contact-name(name="name" type="text")
    if errors().name
      p.error {errors().name}
  .field
    label(for="contact-email") Email
    input#contact-email(name="email" type="email")
    if errors().email
      p.error {errors().email}
  .field
    label(for="contact-message") Message
    textarea#contact-message(name="message")
    if errors().message
      p.error {errors().message}
  button(type="submit") Send
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -40
bun run fmt >/dev/null 2>&1; git status --short; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -20

cat > src/routes/_layout.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
import { books } from '../content.config'

const path = ctx.url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/'
const bookSlug = /^\/books\/([^/]+)$/.exec(path)?.[1]

async function isBook(slug: string | undefined) {
  if (slug === undefined)
    return false

  try {
    return (await books.get(decodeURIComponent(slug))) !== undefined
  }
  catch {
    return false
  }
}

const sections: Record<string, string> = { '/books': 'books', '/about': 'about', '/contact': 'contact' }
const section = (await isBook(bookSlug)) ? 'books' : sections[path]

function current(name: string) {
  return section === name ? 'page' : undefined
}
---
header
  a(href="/" aria-current={undefined}) Bookshelf
  nav(aria-label="Main")
    a(href="/books" aria-current={current('books')}) Books
    a(href="/about" aria-current={current('about')}) About
    a(href="/contact" aria-current={current('contact')}) Contact
main
  slot
footer © Bookshelf
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail; bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -3; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i -E 'error|warn' ; kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'kay start'; sleep 1
PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
for u in / /books /books/dracula /books/nope /about /about/x /contact /x; do echo "$u $(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4701$u) $(grep -o 'aria-current="page">[A-Za-z]*' /tmp/o)"; done
